target_collection.label: Target Collection
target_collection.description: The collection where the target is stored

target.label: Target
target.description: The object on which the changes are happening

last_modified_time.label: Last Modified Time
last_modified_time.description: The time the change was last modified

time_requested.label: Time Requested
time_requested.description: The time the change was requested

time_implemented.label: Time Implemented
time_implemented.description: The time the change was implemented

time_denied.label: Time Denied
time_denied.description: The time the change was denied

time_reverted.label: Time Reverted
time_reverted.description: The time the change was reverted

requester.label: Requester
requester.description: The user that requested the change

approver.label: Approver
approver.description: The user that approved the change

denier.label: Denier
denier.description: The user that rejected the change

reverter.label: Reverter
reverter.description: The user that reverted the change

before_requested_data.label: Before Requested Data
before_requested_data.description: The data before the change was requested

after_requested_data.label: After Requested Data
after_requested_data.description: What the data would have been if it was implemented immediately

differential_data.label: Differential Data
differential_data.description: The difference between the before requested and after requested data.  Only numbers are included

before_implemented_data.label: Before Data
before_implemented_data.description: The data before the change was implemented.  If the change has not been implemented, this will be None

after_implemented_data.label: After Data
after_implemented_data.description: The data after the change was implemented.  If the change has not been implemented, this will be None

before_revert_data.label: Before Revert Data
before_revert_data.description: The data before the change was reverted.  If the change has not been reverted, this will be None

after_revert_data.label: After Revert Data
after_revert_data.description: The data after the change was reverted.  If the change has not been reverted, this will be None

request_reason.label: Reason
request_reason.description: The text explanation and/or link to discord message explaining why the change should take place

target_display_name.label: Target Display Name
target_display_name.description: A snapshot of the target's name at request time, so a change (including a not-yet-approved Add, which has no resolved target) can still be identified without a live join

referenced_discord_links.label: Referenced Discord Links
referenced_discord_links.description: Discord message links extracted from request_reason at request time, for future automated or human review to follow

partial.label: Partial
partial.description: True when only some of this change's units were approved/denied, with the rest spun off into the change named by split_into

split_into.label: Split Into
split_into.description: The follow-up Pending change covering the units this change deferred on a partial approve/deny

split_from.label: Split From
split_from.description: The original change this one was spun off from by a partial approve/deny

reverted_units.label: Reverted Units
reverted_units.description: The specific unit paths reverted, when only some of an approved change's units were reverted (status Partially Reverted)

ai_review.label: AI Review History
ai_review.description: One entry per AI review attempt (see helpers/ai_review_helpers.py) -- timestamp, mode (dry_run/live), model, per-unit verdicts and justifications, and any error

ai_reviewed.label: AI Reviewed
ai_reviewed.description: True once at least one AI review attempt has completed (success, skip, or failure) -- prevents the background worker from repeatedly re-claiming the same change

ai_review_claimed_at.label: AI Review Claimed At
ai_review_claimed_at.description: Set transiently while the AI review worker is actively processing this change, to prevent two workers from reviewing (and trying to approve) the same change at once -- cleared when the attempt finishes
